- Agent: ProblemSolving_Expert
  -- Action: Simplify the extracted fractions.

  -- Thought: Simplification involves finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the numerator and denominator.

- Agent: Verification_Expert
  -- Action: Verify the accuracy of the extracted and simplified fractions.

  -- Thought: Ensuring all fractions are correctly simplified and ordered as per their appearance in the image.
